title: sisymbrium austriacum subsp. montivagum
intro: Sisymbrium austriacum subsp. montivagum, commonly known as alpine hemlock, is a plant species within the Brassicaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of alpine hemlock include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
